scope: Historical primary C-S-S-R-S frontend study, 20 designs, guidance 0.28; not a new upstream-build measurement
runtime_scope: One complete serial replay per design/flow; one process per macro; command CPU excludes macro-boundary IO/normalization; process CPU includes them
